versions.changelog:
- Major update: introduces a zero-dependency local proxy to bridge OpenAI Chat Completions with Responses API-only models.
- Supports seamless use of OpenAI-compatible clients with Responses-API-only models like OpenCode Go gpt-5.6-luna.
- Enables streaming, tool call/function support, reasoning content, and multi-modal input through protocol conversion.
- Provides easy setup via Python script; configurable upstream endpoint and proxy host/port.
- Adds troubleshooting guide, compatibility notes, and extensive usage examples and protocol mapping docs.
